component.name: Rclone Explorer
component.summary: rclone GUI: browse, transfer and sync files on all your cloud storage

description.p: Rclone Explorer (formerly Rclone Browser) is a modern rclone GUI. Browse, upload, download and sync files on Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, pCloud, S3 and 70+ other services, with tabs, icon and details views, pausable transfers and saved tasks.
